cautions: Do not use a design effect below1. A floor does not prove cross-block independence.
Winner confirmation compares both incumbent and same-as-of market. NBA historical paired prices are missing, so candidate-minus-market development variance is unavailable.
NFL archived closing prices have no original observation timestamps; their variance is only a retrospective proxy, not same-cutoff market evidence.
The declared 0.01 Brier planning target is larger than the best NBA arm observed improvement0.001692. No observed arm meets the new -0.005 point-improvement criterion in this development cohort.
No actual family size, power, dependence adjustment, future window or independent power review has been chosen.

NBA.existing: projectNbaGames emits projectedHomeMargin and clamp(sigmoid(mean/7.45),.02,.98) for home winner only.
NBA.missing: No separately tested, pinned line-specific margin CDF/PMF, integer-line push mass or unconditional win/push/loss candidate/incumbent artifacts. Extending the winner mapping now is a new model/version.

NFL.existing: Live nfl-model.js contains independentHomeMargin and 1-normalCdf(-homeSpread,independentHomeMargin,13.6). Live moneyline/spread shrinkage=0; reported simulation uses a market-blended margin when market spread exists.
NFL.missing: No separately frozen independent spread candidate and incumbent artifacts with development report, exact-line win/push/loss accounting and parity tests. Continuous normal raw formula has no integer push mass; market-blended simulation is not the required independent distribution.

blockers.detail: Numerical arms exist; freeze a complete candidate plus an explicit same-cutoff incumbent, feature and source-schema artifact. Do not substitute coefficient-only object hashes for full manifests.

Existing winner collector captures the two baseline implementations; rest/defense/both future feature/inference capture is not wired or parity-tested. Registering their bytes alone cannot generate their prospective forecasts.
Descriptive paired variance is available below but no reviewed dependence assumption, family size or complete market-relative power plan exists.
Complete project-wide previous-development/holdout inventories and access history are not established by these experiment files.
Both sports need separately developed/tested frozen candidate and incumbent line-specific distributions; current binary winner arms do not qualify.
No chosen future start/end, complete official schedule and independently retained immutable registration receipt precede capture. Future season schedule gaps must remain explicit.

Before activation, verify both-side lineup evidence, exact paired prices <=300s old, candidate/incumbent cutoff parity and immutable timely capture. Current rolling evidence is development, not automatically confirmation.
A fixed final analysis and unopened holdout access record are required; existing public research outputs cannot be silently relabeled blinded confirmation.
